title: AegisOps Local Egress Proof Record (Tier 1 Local-Only)
description: Served exclusively by the Local Collector inspection API (127.0.0.1:8001). NEVER uploaded to or queried by Tier 2 SaaS.

raw_event_local_only.description: Original raw Tier 1 telemetry event retained locally for side-by-side judge inspection. NEVER crosses trust boundary.

redacted_fields.description: Names of sensitive raw fields kept local and excluded from outbound metadata.

outbound_payload.description: Parsed allow-listed metadata payload (null if rejected by local policy).

outbound_canonical_json.description: Exact canonical UTF-8 JSON string transmitted over HTTP and hashed into payload_sha256.
